svg.aria-label: PlacebAIStudio, hero unit, private repository with a live demo: Every effect works, except none of them touch your audio. Reverb echoes your clicks, bass boost drops the buttons, and export hands back a silent master. Champion, Rage Quit Award, MALFUNCTION Hackathon 2026. Built with React, TypeScript, Vite, Vitest, Matter.js, XState, Claude.
